description: Search Malt freelancers by skill, role, rate, experience and market, or enrich specific profile URLs. No login, cookies or proxy setup required.

availability.description: Filter by the availability status Malt reports. Most search results are already available; `ANY` disables this filter.
availability.title: Availability

badge.description: Only include freelancers holding this Malt quality badge.
badge.title: Quality badge

businessSector.description: Filter by the client sectors a freelancer has worked in. `ANY` includes every sector.
businessSector.title: Client business sector

category.description: Malt category key, e.g. `backend_developer`, `frontend_developer`, `data_scientist`. Leave empty to search all categories.
category.title: Category key (optional)

experienceLevel.description: Filter by Malt's experience band. `ANY` includes every level.
experienceLevel.title: Experience level

includeProfileDetails.description: Also open each freelancer's profile page to add languages, experience band, categories, description, portfolio count and work-history years. Adds one request per profile.
includeProfileDetails.title: Enrich with full profile details

language.description: Only include freelancers who speak this language. `ANY` includes every language.
language.title: Spoken language

location.description: Only keep freelancers whose city, region or country matches this text, e.g. `Paris`, `Berlin`, `Spain`. Leave empty for all locations.
location.title: Location (city, region or country)

market.description: Which Malt marketplace to search. This also sets the profile URL domain and the search API country filter.
market.title: Market (Malt country)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of freelancer records to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: How many search-result pages to request per query. Malt's guest API exposes ~24 profiles per page and may ignore page 2+; repeated draws fill the gap.
maxPages.title: Max server pages per query

maxRate.description: Only include freelancers whose publicly listed daily rate is at or below this amount, in EUR.
maxRate.title: Maximum daily rate (EUR)

maxRepetitions.description: Each draw returns a randomised set of up to 24 profiles. More draws surface more unique freelancers. Stops early when draws add nothing new.
maxRepetitions.title: Max draws per query

minRate.description: Only include freelancers whose publicly listed daily rate is at or above this amount, in EUR.
minRate.title: Minimum daily rate (EUR)

minRating.description: Only include freelancers with an average client rating at or above this value (0-5). Leave empty to include all; freelancers without a rating are not excluded.
minRating.title: Minimum average rating

minReviews.description: Only include freelancers with at least this many client reviews. Leave empty to include all; freelancers without reviews are not excluded.
minReviews.title: Minimum number of reviews

mode.description: Search the Malt directory, or enrich a list of profile URLs you already have.
enumTitles: Search freelancers by skill, filters and market
mode.title: Mode

profileUrls.description: Malt profile URLs, slugs or profile URLs from any Malt market, e.g. `https://www.malt.fr/profile/johndoe`. Used in mode=byProfileUrls.
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs (mode=byProfileUrls)

searchQueries.description: Optional list of extra queries searched after `searchQuery`. Each query is searched separately and results are de-duplicated, e.g. ["react", "typescript", "node.js"].
searchQueries.title: Additional search queries

searchQuery.description: Skill, role or keyword to search for, e.g. `react`, `python developer`, `data scientist`. Used in mode=searchFreelancers.
searchQuery.title: Search query (skill or role)

sortBy.description: Order the final dataset. `Relevance` keeps Malt's own ordering.
sortBy.title: Sort results

speciality.description: Malt speciality key, e.g. `React.js`, `Python`, `SEO`. Leave empty to search all specialities.
speciality.title: Speciality / skill key (optional)

title: Malt Freelancer Skill & Rate Finder Input
